schema:alternativeHeadline: Scan page 30 of Male Express, The, no. 8. Line drawing of a young man in profile with short dark hair. Empress I Jose and Emperor III Bob Cramer sit on an open parade car, one wearing a dark cap and vest. Empress X Doris sits in a decorated parade car surrounded by spectators. Marchers carrying a broad banner precede Grand Duchess Lee Raymond’s float on a crowded city street. Grand Duchess Lee Raymond poses in a voluminous light-colored gown. Dowager Empress IX Frieda smiles through a vehicle window while wearing a wide-brimmed hat. Estuardo of Finocchios rides with an elaborate float bearing his name through a street crowd.
